codes.evidence_quote: the key elements of this art form -- the energy, vitality, grace, beauty, and intensity of feelings -- were expressed so well by this group
codes.rationale: The review names aesthetic criteria and applies them to judge the performance's success.

codes.evidence_quote: In a program designed to bring to high school students the language, history and culture of Spain
codes.rationale: The performance is framed as institutional access to Spanish cultural knowledge for students across a transnational setting.

codes.evidence_quote: The company used guitar, song and dance solos and group performances to share their gypsy expression of flamenco.
codes.rationale: Gypsy identity is not merely demographic here; it frames the company as embodying and representing a particular flamenco expression.

codes.evidence_quote: Never had there been such a dancer — of that I was certain.
codes.rationale: The memoir canonizes Carmen Amaya through superlative status and exemplary artistic uniqueness.

codes.evidence_quote: She was an essence. She was flamenco!
codes.rationale: The passage presents Amaya as the genuine embodiment of flamenco itself.

codes.evidence_quote: I had the unique experience of working my apprenticeship with the late great Vicente Escudero, that "macho" charismatic master of them all. I remember he always called me muy maja and my heart would swell with pride when he said I had duende. My training with him was of great value.
codes.rationale: Escudero is positioned as an authoritative master whose training and recognition legitimate the narrator's flamenco development.

codes.evidence_quote: She was very pleased that I looked like one of the "tribe". The gypsies accepted me as one of their own and I loved to be with them.
